newsitem.title: UK: Esso UK says no end to petrol price campaign.
newsitem.headline: Esso UK says no end to petrol price campaign.

text.p: Esso threw down the gauntlet to other gasoline retailers in Britain on Thursday by confirming a long-term commitment to its "Pricewatch" campaign which it launched in January, sparking a price war in the UK market.
"Pricewatch is here to stay for the long term despite speculation to the contrary by our competitors," Mark Cash, Esso's Retail Planning and Economics Manager said in a statement on Thursday.

"Customer response has exceeded our expectations and we have seen one million extra cars on our forecourts every week. With our new advertising we are re-affirming to motorists that they can get high quality fuels at supermarket prices" he said.

Esso, subsidiary of U.S. Exxon Corp, said it will invest millions of pounds in a new national television advertising campaign starting on November 8 for an initial five week period. The campaign was aimed at wooing customers away from supermarket petrol stations, it said.
Analysts see little improvement in retail margins despite the shakeout of 3,000 forecourts and a three way refinery merger between Elf, Murco and Chevron announced on Wednesday.
